name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Frosted And Transparent Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium-quality acrylic with a unique 2-layer construction, combining frosted acrylic and transparent acrylic for a dimensional and elegant display effect.
    - Each layer is 3mm thick, providing durability, stability, and a premium finish while maintaining a lightweight feel for easy display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes to suit different decorative and event needs:
    6 x 8 inches (15.24 x 20.32 cm)
    8 x 12 inches (20.32 x 30.48 cm)
    12 x 18 inches (30.48 x 45.72 cm)
    18 x 24 inches (45.72 x 60.96 cm)
    24 x 36 inches (60.96 x 91.44 cm)
    30 x 30 inches (76.2 x 76.2 cm)
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors, crisp details, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The artwork is printed on single side only, ensuring a clean and professional display from the front while preserving the layered depth effect.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Elegant double-layer acrylic design creates a premium dimensional look.
    - Combines frosted softness with transparent clarity for a modern luxury effect.
    - Perfect for wedding welcome signs, engagement displays, anniversary décor, baby showers, birthdays, and event signage.
    - Ideal for home décor, memorial displays, business signage, or personalized keepsakes.
    - Lightweight yet durable for tabletop, easel, or wall display.
    - Customizable with names, dates, quotes, or unique artwork.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This personalized acrylic sign makes a thoughtful and stylish gift for anyone on any special occasion, including: Weddings, Anniversaries, Housewarming, Birthdays, Baby Showers, Bridal Showers, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, Memorial Celebrations.
    - A timeless keepsake designed to celebrate love, memories, and special moments with elegance and personalization.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 2-Layer Frosted And Transparent Acrylic Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
